issues.detail: Hebrew 'עִם לְבָבִי' means 'with my heart' (i.e., 'I have it in my heart' / 'I intend'), but Chinese '與我的心同去' adds '同去' (go together), which is not in the Hebrew and changes the sense to a physical going.
Hebrew 'מִמֶּנּוּ' means 'from us' (first person plural), but Chinese '向他們' means 'toward them' (third person plural), reversing the referent and changing who the anger turns away from.
